input: Find bribery and market-manipulation enforcement actions involving Glencore since 2018

entity.group: Glencore group; Glencore plc is the ultimate parent

events.jurisdiction: United States — Southern District of New York
events.parties: Glencore International A.G.; not Glencore plc
events.amount: USD 428,521,173 criminal fine and USD 272,185,792 criminal forfeiture liability, before credits for parallel resolutions; as_of: 2022-05-24
events.summary: Glencore International A.G. pleaded guilty to conspiracy to violate the FCPA through corrupt payments involving officials in Nigeria, Cameroon, Ivory Coast, Equatorial Guinea, Brazil, Venezuela and the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

events.type: Market manipulation — DOJ criminal commodity-price enforcement
events.parties: Glencore Ltd.; relevant conduct included employees formerly working at Chemoil Corporation
events.amount: USD 341,221,682 criminal fine and USD 144,417,203 criminal forfeiture, before credits against the parallel CFTC resolution; as_of: 2022-05-24
events.summary: Glencore Ltd. pleaded guilty to conspiracy to manipulate Platts fuel-oil benchmarks for Los Angeles and the U.S. Gulf Coast to benefit physical trading contracts and derivatives positions.

events.type: Market manipulation and corruption — CFTC civil enforcement
events.jurisdiction: United States — Commodity Futures Trading Commission
events.parties: Glencore International A.G.; Glencore Ltd.; Chemoil Corporation
events.amount: USD 1,186,345,850 gross monetary sanction, comprising USD 865,630,784 civil penalty and USD 320,715,066 disgorgement, with offsets of up to USD 852,797,810 for DOJ-resolution payments; as_of: 2022-05-24
events.summary: The CFTC settled findings of manipulation or attempted manipulation of Platts fuel-oil benchmarks and associated derivatives, corrupt payments, and misuse of confidential information; the gross sanction overlaps with DOJ penalties and must not be added without adjusting for offsets.

events.type: Bribery — Brazilian Federal Prosecutor’s Office resolution
events.parties: Glencore International AG; investigation concerned certain Glencore affiliates and Petrobras
events.summary: Glencore International AG reached a separate resolution with Brazilian federal prosecutors concerning Petrobras-related bribery allegations arising from Operation Car Wash.

events.type: Bribery and failure to prevent bribery — SFO prosecution and sentencing
events.jurisdiction: United Kingdom — England and Wales, Southwark Crown Court
events.parties: Glencore Energy UK Ltd; not Glencore plc
events.amount: GBP 182,935,392 fines, GBP 93,479,338.95 confiscation and GBP 4,550,362 prosecution costs; as_of: 2022-11-03
events.summary: Following guilty pleas, Glencore Energy UK Ltd was sentenced for bribery and failure to prevent bribery connected with obtaining oil business in Nigeria, Cameroon, Ivory Coast, Equatorial Guinea and South Sudan.

events.type: Corruption — settlement of DRC government claims
events.parties: Glencore International AG, on behalf of its Congolese-associated companies; Democratic Republic of the Congo
events.summary: Glencore announced a settlement covering DRC corruption claims arising from historical conduct, with admissions limited to conduct already acknowledged in its DOJ resolution and continued implementation of its compliance programme.

events.type: Bribery — Nigerian government penalty and compensation settlement
events.parties: Glencore International A.G.; Federal Republic of Nigeria, represented by the Federal Ministry of Justice
events.amount: USD 50 million agreed penalty and compensation; as_of: 2024-05-24
events.summary: Nigeria’s attorney-general announced that settlement negotiations with Glencore International A.G. had concluded concerning activities in Nigeria following the overseas bribery proceedings.

events.jurisdiction: Switzerland — Office of the Attorney General
events.amount: CHF 2 million fine and USD 150 million compensation claim; as_of: 2024-08-05
events.summary: The Swiss prosecutor imposed a summary penalty order for inadequate organisational measures to prevent a business partner’s bribery of foreign officials in a DRC mining transaction, while abandoning part of the other investigated conduct.

events.jurisdiction: Netherlands — Dutch Public Prosecutor’s Office and FIOD
events.summary: Dutch prosecutors dismissed their DRC mining-related bribery case against Glencore International AG following the Swiss penalty order, preferring resolution in Switzerland rather than continuing the parallel Dutch corporate case.

events.type: Corruption and related money laundering — Jersey investigation
events.jurisdiction: Jersey — Economic Crime and Confiscation Unit, Law Officers’ Department
events.summary: Glencore disclosed notification of a Jersey investigation into group corruption, related money laundering and the accuracy of IPO-related assurances, with the investigation still disclosed in its latest half-year report; as_of: 2026-06-30.

output.assessment: As of 2026-11-10, my assessment is elevated historical financial-crime risk given the corporate bribery convictions and benchmark-manipulation findings; the separately named subsidiary defendants should not be treated as convictions of Glencore plc, the Swiss-headquartered group parent (entity source_url: https://www.glencore.com/.rest/api/v1/documents/static/9b103e11-72e7-40bf-ae7c-eabe57361522/GLEN-2025-Annual-Report.pdf). Glencore reports that its DOJ monitorships ended early in 2025 and its plea-agreement term concluded in 2026 (source_url: https://www.glencore.com/sustainability/ethics-and-compliance). The Jersey investigation remained disclosed at 2026-06-30, while separate UK proceedings against former employees remain open with trial listed for 2027-10-04 (source_urls: https://www.glencore.com/.rest/api/v1/documents/static/98cf0f2a-ede7-4ced-9539-061198c3b6be/GLEN-2026-Half-Year-Report.pdf ; https://www.gov.uk/sfo-cases/glencore-employees).
missing_fields: events[9].date: exact day of September 2024 notification

cost_basis: tokens x list price + $10 per 1K web search calls
